title: Dental PPO Plans Service Center Article: Not-Eligible Denials Made during a Premium Grace Period
content:
**In brief.** A Dental PPO Plans claim line can stand denied as not eligible although its date of service falls within the enrollment's coverage (on or after the coverage effective date and, when a termination date is set, on or before it), the denial having been made while the funding billing account was in a premium grace period during which such a line is adjudicated normally. Such a line is reprocessed as a line adjudicated normally, and the grace-period reprocessing rule fixes its corrected patient share.

**Which line.** The enrollment's most recently decided line whose decision is a denial carrying the not-eligible remark. Where several such lines share that latest decision date, this rule is not used and each is reprocessed under the base rules. Where that line's date of service falls outside the enrollment's coverage, it was rightly denied and this rule is not used.

**Reprocessed under the base rules instead:** a line of an enrollment whose plan changed that falls within the new waiting period for a service class the prior plan also covered; a line that a frequency or age limit would deny; a bridge, denture or implant replacing a tooth extracted before the coverage effective date; a line on a plan that banks rollover dollars whose payment would be limited by the remaining annual maximum; a line of a child whose subscriber has two or more children enrolled on individual exchange enrollments; and a line on an account with more than three enrolled persons.

**Kept on the corrected decision.** The denied line's claim number, line number, practice, network status, procedure, service class, tooth, extraction date, dates, receipt date, benefit year, billed amount, allowed amount, alternate allowance and other-carrier payment.

**When the patient share is fixed.** A reprocessed grace-period line's patient share is fixed only after the person's most recently decided paid basic- or major-class line, when it is booked to this line's benefit year although its date of service falls in an earlier one and was paid at a prior plan's coinsurance for a service whose new waiting period the person's earlier Cascade DHMO coverage has already served, has been reprocessed. In other words, while that paid line still stands booked to this line's benefit year at the prior plan's coinsurance, the grace-period line's patient share is not yet fixed.

**Booking tool `reprocess_grace_denial_4c0e9d17`.**
- *Capability:* reprocesses one Dental PPO claim line that stands denied as not eligible for a date of service on which the enrollment was in force while its funding billing account was in a premium grace period. It books a corrected decision that replaces the denial, carrying over the denied line's claim number, line number, practice, network status, procedure, tooth, extraction date, dates of service and receipt, benefit year, billed, allowed and alternate allowances and other-carrier payment, and records the corrected deductible, coinsurance, total plan payment and patient share with the reprocessed remark (ADJUSTED_REPROCESSED) and today's decision date. In the same write any deductible taken is posted to the person's deductible and the payment or patient share is posted to the accumulator named by the accumulator track. Afterwards the member's Explanation of Benefits shows the corrected decision and the accumulators reflect it.
- *Invocation:* agent-side; the agent unlocks `reprocess_grace_denial_4c0e9d17` and then calls it.
- *Parameters:* `denied_claim_line_id` (reference number of the denied claim-line decision being replaced, as returned by the dental claim-line lookup for the member's enrollment); `deductible_applied` (deductible taken on the corrected decision, USD with 2 decimals, rounded half up, 0.00 when none); `coinsurance_pct` (percentage the corrected decision pays at, whole number 0 to 100); `plan_paid` (corrected total plan payment, USD with 2 decimals, rounded half up, 0.00 when nothing is paid); `member_responsibility` (corrected patient share, USD with 2 decimals, rounded half up, 0.00 when the member owes nothing); `accumulator_track` (accumulator posted besides any deductible: `annual_maximum` when the plan payment counts against the annual maximum; `pediatric_in_network` when the person receives the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment and the line is from an in-network practice, so nothing is posted to the annual maximum and the patient share is posted to the pediatric out-of-pocket accumulator; `pediatric_out_of_network` when the person receives that treatment and the line is from an out-of-network practice, so nothing is posted to either).
- *Return:* on success, `status` ("reprocessed"), `dental_claim_line_id` (the new corrected decision), `original_claim_line_id` (the denial replaced), `plan_paid` and `member_responsibility` (USD, 2 decimals), `accumulator_track` (as booked) and `adjudicated_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
